title: Do you think I could make graphics for my game with AI?
author: OverallDistance7325
selftext:
The game in question is about gladiator management. Each fight is a deterministic simulation. Much like the football manager games sorta. 

What are the capabilities of AI so far? Could it generate rigged 2D skeletons with swappable gear and graphics for a fight? 

How would you do it?

comments.author: tastygnar
comments.body: Short answer is yes, but probably not a 1 shot solution.  Theres lots of ways to handle swapping equipment, I would want more info like is the swap just cosmetic with different stats or does the swap need to account for new geometry, etc.

comments.author: tomqmasters
comments.body: AI can help, but you probably won't be able to make a game that people will want to play without opening a graphics program and doing some work.

comments.author: kytheon
comments.body:
"What are the capabilities of AI so far?"

Bro.

"How do I make game"

comments.author: DamienNF
comments.body: I'm using Scenario to generate assets, then Photoshop to cut and fix smaller things and Spine for skeleton animation, but actually I believe game engine can do that too.

comments.author: Bal_oney77
comments.body:
I actually made a system to handle this same idea in my game (which is also a gm manager game lol..Bball Sim - Dynasty Basketball). There's a headshot editor feature that allows you to swap in different layers (face, eyes, nose, facial hair, hair, etc) and customize colors...which are all svgs with named indexes layered on top of each other...so, thats how you *could* do it...or you could create different layers as sprites...

The thing is though, ai did help -- to quickly build a custom admin editor tool where I could easily draw all the separate layers and set everything up...it *did not* create them all for me...it just doesnt do good enough with assets like that. If you want to know more about how I set it up feel free to dm me.

comments.author: Livid_Shallot5701
comments.body: Visuals, especially animations are ai weakest Points in gamedev atm

comments.author: Serasul
comments.body:
Retro diffusion can do:

Pixelart:  
\- Items  
\- Charters  
\- Portraits  
\- Animations  
\- Textures  
\- Backgrounds  
\- Effects  
\- If you like something you can make other assets out of it that use the same colors,elements and style  
\- GUI/UI Elements  
\- Text and Numbers  
\- Different Perspectives and Styles  
\- A free tool to fix Pixelart so it aligns with a Pixelart Grid

Its the best Pixelart Model out there and its made vor Gamedevs.  
Search for the Name and join the discord, many Gamedevs there can show you more and they help each other there.
